scope: Kaba Aye Pagoda in Yangon in March 2015, including the central gilded stupa, circular prayer hall and its outward gabled entrance porches.

originalReview.notes: Shows the gilded central stupa, white circular hall with gold crenellations, decorated pointed arch bays, green mosaic columns and red-and-gold gabled porch.

quallaSearch.notes: The March 2015 exterior photograph matches the native Wikimedia Commons original byte for byte. Creator and uploader C1815 dedicated it to CC0. The other two published Qualla photos are interiors and were not used for exterior details.
